name: daily-trader
description: Paper-first portfolio monitoring and market decision support.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@daily-trader/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker
scripts.market-data:provider-smoke: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker && node workers/market-data/dist/provider-smoke.js
scripts.market-data:recording:verify: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker && node workers/market-data/dist/market-data-cli.js recording:verify
scripts.market-data:replay: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker && node workers/market-data/dist/market-data-cli.js replay
scripts.market-data:status: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker && node workers/market-data/dist/market-data-cli.js status
scripts.smoke: npm run build:packages && npm run smoke --workspace=@daily-trader/api && npm run smoke --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker
scripts.phase2:service-verify: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker && node workers/market-data/dist/phase2-verify.js
scripts.start:api: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=@daily-trader/api
scripts.start:web: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=@daily-trader/web
scripts.start:worker: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=@daily-trader/market-data-worker
